title: Synchronous switch pair with enforced break-before-make
description: Complementary half-bridge switch pair: ctl high (against ctlref, threshold vth) conducts nhi-nsw and isolates nsw-nlo; ctl low does the reverse. Every turn-ON command is delayed by tdead after the opposite turn-OFF, so both conduction commands are never asserted together. When body_diodes=1 the block includes antiparallel ideal-diode freewheel paths (forward drop about vdio); this is a declared topology choice required for inductive commutation, not a hidden regularization.

output_drive.edge_convention: conductance follows shaped drive edges of duration tedge
conductance follows shaped drive edges of duration tedge
conductance follows shaped drive edges of duration tedge

parameters.name: vth
parameters.description: Control threshold against ctlref; ambiguity band is 0.9*vth..1.1*vth.

parameters.name: tdead
parameters.description: Break-before-make dead time from opposite turn-OFF command to this switch's turn-ON command. The floor is 2 ps, not zero: every executable backend issues the turn-OFF command through a 1 ps delay stage, so a dead time at or below 1 ps would let the two conduction commands overlap and silently break this block's one structural guarantee.

parameters.name: tedge
parameters.description: Drive edge shaping duration; conduction transitions are smooth over this window.

parameters.name: vdio
parameters.description: Forward drop of the declared freewheel diodes at approximately 1 A (exponential-ideal law around that point).

parameters.name: body_diodes
parameters.description: 1 includes antiparallel freewheel diodes (topology choice); 0 removes them and the composition owes the freewheel path.

state.name: drive commands
state.value_before_first_event: The initial transient solution resolves both drives from the initial control level; the turn-ON delay applies from the first control edge, not at t=0.

unsupported.behavior: AC linearizes the switches at their OP conduction state; no switching behavior is represented.
Noise contributions are absent, not zero-modeled; report noise as unavailable.

regularization.name: smooth conductance interpolation
regularization.magnitude: log-interpolated resistance between ron and roff over the drive band
regularization.tested_error_bound: plateau conduction error < 0.1% of ron/roff targets

regularization.name: disabled-diode residue
regularization.magnitude: is=1e-30 A with emission coefficient 100 when body_diodes=0
regularization.tested_error_bound: residual conduction < 1 pA for any forward drop under 40 V

limitations: No charge storage, gate charge, or switching-loss model; commutation energy is not represented.
No shoot-through model: the contract guarantees the commands never overlap, so cross-conduction cannot be studied with this block.
Diode model is exponential-ideal: no reverse recovery, no breakdown.

timing.ambiguity_window: control band 0.9*vth..1.1*vth; conduction transitions occupy tedge.
timing.latency_definition: tdead = time from opposite turn-OFF command to turn-ON command, exact at the digital command layer; electrical conduction adds up to tedge of shaped edge.

xspice-cosim.notes: The compiled 2-state core holds its last value while the control bridge output is UNKNOWN, so inside the declared band (vth*0.9 .. vth*1.1) the drive commands switch at the band-exit crossing instead of ramping through a midpoint; both behaviors lie inside the declared-unspecified band. The core adds a fixed ~6 ps event delay symmetrically to both drive commands, which cancels in the break-before-make interval arithmetic.
